# ghost/flip-a-coin

Flip a coin (F-Droid): toss a coin with one tap and read heads or tails. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/flip-a-coin
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/flip-a-coin open_coin --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/flip-a-coin flip --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/flip-a-coin flip_many --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/flip-a-coin get_coin --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open_coin`: Open the Flip a coin app
- `flip`: Flip a coin for me
- `flip_many`: Flip a coin five times
- `get_coin`: What does the coin show?
